title: Multi-Agent Route Planning as a QUBO Problem
summary: Multi-Agent Route Planning considers selecting vehicles, each associated with a single predefined route, such that route-level coverage utility is maximized while redundant spatial overlaps are limited. This paper gives a formal problem definition, proves NP-hardness by reduction from the Weighted Set Packing problem, and derives a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization formulation whose coefficients directly encode route utility rewards and pairwise overlap penalties.
